title.zh: 提升南拉瑙省马拉维市 Amai Pakpak 医疗中心并为其拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Upgrading the Amai Pakpak Medical Center in Marawi City, Province of Lanao Del Sur and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Upgrading the Amai Pakpak Medical Center in Marawi City, Province of Lanao Del Sur and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 7 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2018/ra_11103_2018.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of the Amai Pakpak Medical Center in Marawi City, Province of Lanao del Sur is hereby increased from two hundred (200) to four hundred (400) beds.

The existing hospital facilities and professional health care services of the Amai Pakpak Medical Center are hereby upgraded and increased to conform with and be commensurate to the increase in bed capacity. The number of medical personnel shall be correspondingly increased.
The increase in the bed capacity of Amai Pakpak Medical Center shall be implemented incrementally for a period of not more than two (2) years from the approval of this Act.
The construction and upgrading of the hospital facilities and services shall be under the direct supervision and control of the Department of Health.
The Secretary of Health shall immediately include in the Department’s programs the implementation of this Act, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Republic Act No. 7943 is hereby repealed.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
